// APIs generated by Microsoft.Windows.CsWin32 into the internal Windows.Win32.PInvoke class.
// The public EverythingToolbar.Helpers.NativeMethods facade wraps these so cross-assembly
// callers keep their IntPtr-based signatures.
//
// Only the low-risk, value-in/value-out P/Invokes live here. The message-only window
// (ANSI CreateWindowEx + WndProc), the keyboard hook chain, SendMessage+COPYDATASTRUCT and
// keybd_event are still hand-written in NativeMethods.cs — see the comment there.
FindWindow
FindWindowEx
FlashWindow
GetForegroundWindow
GetWindowThreadProcessId
SetForegroundWindow
SetActiveWindow
AttachThreadInput
GetDpiForWindow
DwmFlush
keybd_event
RegNotifyChangeKeyValue
SystemParametersInfo
SendMessage
SetWindowsHookEx
UnhookWindowsHookEx
CallNextHookEx
ShellExecuteEx
SHELLEXECUTEINFOW
CreateProcess
STARTUPINFOW
PROCESS_INFORMATION
CloseHandle
SHOpenFolderAndSelectItems
SHParseDisplayName
